rules.title: Protect the items you want
rules.action: Check your auto-sell and upgrade filters before the next run. Keep your goal items out of those filters.
rules.tradeoff: Keeping more drops takes bag space.

rules.title: Make the next pull safer
rules.action: Try smaller pulls and agree on an escape route. Let health and mana recover before the next fight.
rules.tradeoff: A slower start may mean fewer kills per hour.

rules.title: Review spells that did not land
rules.action: Check the resisted spells in your log. Try a better-suited spell or an easier target, and compare the next run.
rules.tradeoff: Changing spells can lower damage or add more buttons to manage.

rules.title: Give someone the control job
rules.action: Assign one player to manage extra enemies. If control still feels weak, bring a buddy with stronger control or choose a gentler camp.
rules.tradeoff: This is a build-planning estimate. Spell level, resists and player skill still matter.

rules.title: Plan more healing support
rules.action: Give a player time to focus on healing. Try a healing buddy or shorter fights if recovery is holding you back.
rules.tradeoff: More healing support may reduce damage output.

rules.title: Focus the next trip on one item
rules.action: Check which enemy drops your top goal, then plan a route to that camp. Use your own past drops or open the zone guide to review its source.
rules.tradeoff: An item missing from this log does not prove it dropped or was left behind. A longer run does not promise a rare drop.

rules.title: Start the log before entering
rules.action: Turn logging on before you zone in. Check loot chat filters and save a trip report before changing log files.
rules.tradeoff: Events outside the log cannot be recovered by the meter.

rules.title: Check your faction plan
rules.action: Review the zone's faction goals before repeating a camp. Compare a fresh faction export after the hunt.
rules.tradeoff: Loot and combat lines do not establish your current faction points.

rules.title: Secure your gains before another run
rules.action: Check your bags or depot, then set a new goal or stop here. Review which camp gave you the items you wanted.
rules.tradeoff: This report records gains during the trip. Later sales, trades and turn-ins may change what you still own.

rules.title: Choose a loot goal for next time
rules.action: Add the exact item name and how many you want. The next report can compare your gains with that goal.
rules.tradeoff: A wish list is a plan; it does not prove a drop source or a drop rate.
